Lewd and hot Mommy (sometimes futa) x (mostly) Shota H Anthology, by various authors.
Commissioned by lzzy.
Scanlated by Tabunne Scans.

raw: https://e-hentai.org/g/3789368/2dcc023802/

We're recruiting editors, cleaners and typesetters! If you're interested, please apply via discord!

Another commission, yay! By our amazing regular commissioner, lzzy!

We've been working on this along other projects for the past months and Gosh, this took quite some time to do, but now it's here! ...meanwhile someone also did a MTL of it, but I hope that the quality we make beats that, even if it took a while to get this massive anthology done.
(though we did make some mistakes with the resolution of raws, that we realised way too late, so, many (but not all) doujins uses the standardised resolution raws instead of the highest possible resolution... sorry about that...)

Normally... as much as I like picking up whatever I like from some anthologies, I don't like to pick up a full anthology usually (because there's almost always some stuff in it that I dislike, or don't care about), but some way or other, lzzy managed to persuade me and, honestly, I'm glad for that! ...But also, it did have some parts that I didn't like, like that "Shota x Onee rampage" (lol), or that one Mario doujin with its nonsensical format and tons of text (not that it's bad otherwise though) ...that one took so much time to do XD lol

That being said, the anthology is generally quite the gold mine - and even if there are some parts that I didn't like, they are all good too.
If some actually reads my silly uploader comments, they might know I love to blabber a lot about stuff regarding the doujin (and often whatever barely related random bullshit too) but given the sheer length of this anthology, I guess I'll try to avoid commenting on each one-by-one, because it would end up with an anthology-sized wall of text... XD

But otherwise, let's see... apparently, this "Amaenbou" is a franchise, and has plenty of related stuff, mostly audio it seems... somehow I haven't heard about it prior to this doujin, but now that I did, I wonder what sort of related doujins will pop up in the future...?
It also has some futa stuff too, so that's a wonderful bonus~
There so much potential for many-many more great doujins in this franchise... Delicious!

By the way by the way, it's unclear if it's really shotas or not - some doujins outright feature grown adult guys - but also, there are seemingly various drugs, one can turn one smoller temporarily, so I guess some patrons might be actually shotas, and some rely on such to spend some quality mommy x shota time there, even if they're no longer actually shotas... - it was also never outright stated that the establisment is only for guys, so I can't help but wonder, surely there are some female patrons as well, afterall, I'm sure there are girls (whether lolis or adults) as well who enjoy some quality time with lovely mommies. and then it brings up new questions about the "turn into a futa" drug, if it's only for mommies, or not...

But also... how could you... add in a drug that temporarily makes one forgot about he ever ejaculated, and only use that in only one short doujin (that was a bit underwhelming too, IMO) ?! Come on, that has so much cute potential...

Can we have some more "Mommies doing silly-hot shenenigans with weird exotic lewd drugs"...? For science!

Anyway, enough blabbering, right?
I hope you enjoy reading it~!
